description.value: The Old Spaghetti Factory is a Canadian chain restaurant anchoring a corner of Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, operating out of one of its earliest Canadian locations. It offers a distinctive 'It's all included' dining model where every entrée arrives with sourdough bread, soup or salad, spumoni ice cream, and coffee — a filling proposition after a long ride. The Gastown location carries a well-known local reputation for being haunted, lending extra atmosphere to the Victorian-era surroundings.
